name: hilbana
description: Everything Hilbana for Claude Code in one install: persistent per-project agent memory (an engram replacement, with hooks that load context on open and save a summary on close) + the human+agent workflow framework (pull queue, the /hilbana:plan orchestrator, and the cycle prompts claim_next/finish/review served by the MCP itself) + Hilbana's MCP server auto-registered. Commands and skills are written in Spanish.

api_key.title: Hilbana API key
api_key.description: Create it under Settings → API keys in any workspace you belong to (format hil_…). The key identifies YOU: it reaches every workspace you are a member of, and that one is just the default — the one used when a call does not say otherwise. Agent memory always lives in that default workspace.

base_url.title: Hilbana URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your deployment, without /mcp.
